pages.title: Brewing Dessert
pages.text: Brew an Awkward Potion with a Cake. Drink it yourself, or use the bottle on one of your tame maids.

pages.title: Sweetness
pages.text: Each drink restores full health. For 10 minutes the drinker gains 20% attack damage and 2 blocks of attack reach. Drinking again renews the duration. The 20% applies after flat bonuses such as the owner's Fear resonance.

pages.title: A Sweet Scent
pages.text: A sweet maid keeps her Trust, gains 1 favorability every 30 seconds and stays at 15 Hunger or higher. A tame maid within 5 blocks who lacks Sweetness may say “Wow, you smell so sweet!” Each speaker can say it once every 5 minutes.
